spec: ISA0.9 §3.6 frame layout and §11.1 K25 complete lift.ret Globals delivery scan
derivation: An unused eight-bit global location requires W_1=max(4,8)=8 when the instantiated closure contains lift.ret, even though listed call/return slots have maxima [4,4,2]. With P=3 the frame has 2*3+8+4+2+1=21 bits and four frames retain 84 bits. The unchanged lift.ret recipe must bind N=8 and the complete Globals list.
